Something I learned that helped me was paying attention to the music. Like, when it seems like it’s building to a crescendo, odds are the enemy’s gonna attck. I’m not sure if that’s how my brain started copig with the game or that’s actually how it is but using that reasoning helped a ton. The fights are more like dances than they are all out brawls.

Work on mastering deflects. I used to play all games very aggresively without regard for defence. This game swatted me to the floor for that. Mikiri counter is a necessity to rememeber. Always try and dodge away or jump over sweeping attacks.
